Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of σπέος (a grotto); a cavern; by implication, a hiding-place or resort:--cave, den.
BiblicalUsage: A cave is a grave, a hiding place, and a robbers' den. Jesus comes to the grave of Lazarus, and it was a cave with a stone upon it; He says His house of prayer has been made a den of thieves; and at the end the great men hide themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the caves tell one story: men hide in them from God, and the Lord walks into them and calls the dead out.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
